verdict.rationale: WorkOS's only documented bulk-style capability is migration. The CLI migrations tool exports from Auth0 and produces a package of users, organizations, memberships, roles and SSO handoff files for import into AuthKit, so many items can be moved at once. Nothing shows general-purpose bulk operations: no batch API endpoints, bulk update or delete, or bulk actions through the MCP server. Directory Sync's automatic updates and the SDKs' pagination helpers are adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: general batch/bulk API endpoints, bulk update/delete across users or organizations, agent- or CLI-driven bulk actions outside migration, independent corroboration.
